headline: A better vibe for async work.
body: Exploring calmer, more flexible ways for remote teams to communicate, collaborate and stay focused — without unnecessary meetings.
featuresTitle: A calmer way to work together
featureAsyncBody: People share an update when their day starts. Nobody waits on a meeting to hear what changed.
featureMeetingsBody: The update is written once, in short lines. A meeting is optional.
featureToolBody: A daily standup with a summary that leads with who needs help.
stepOneBody: Use the account you already have.
stepTwoBody: See the tools your team has turned on.
stepThreeBody: Share yesterday, today, and what you need.
closeBody: Sign in and open your workspace.
